title: GridSim unit protection file (gridsim-unit-protection/1)
description: Generating units' own relay settings for a study that binds a case GridSim does not read as a v2 case, for example a PSS/E RAW case in dynamics-study (--unit-protection, or adaptive.unitProtection in the study file). It holds unitProtection templates (the class defaults, in the v2 library template shape and checked against the v2 unitProtection kind spec exactly as a v2 case's local templates are) and one entry per unit: the template it takes and, optionally, the unit's own values on top (a per-unit override, with the same provenance rule as a v2 case's override with a unit member). The file is validated against this schema together with the v2 schema set (schemas/v2), whose template, templateRef, parameter value and provenance definitions it uses. Rules the schema subset cannot express are checked in code (V2CaseLoader): every template is of kind unitProtection and active, its parameters pass the kind spec, a template id@rev is defined once, each unit is listed once and takes a template of this file, an entry with params says why (reason), and after resolution every unit must name a unit of the study's case (unknown units are refused).

templates.description: The unitProtection templates (class defaults), in the v2 library template shape. The class name of gridsim.local.NAME@1 is NAME, of any other template its id@rev.

units.description: One entry per unit that carries relays of its own, in the order verdicts and the result list them.

unit.title: Unit protection assignment
unit.description: A unit, the template it takes, and optionally its own values. Resolution per setting: the unit's own value, else the template's, else no relay (nothing is invented).

The unit. For a PSS/E RAW-bound study: the PSS/E machine key <bus>:<id>, the generator record's bus number I and machine ID as the RAW reader stores it (quotes removed, surrounding blanks trimmed, case kept: '1' and 'G1' are different machines), for example 101:1. For a model whose generators carry names: the generator name.

params.description: The unit's own values (a per-unit override of its template): bare values or the object form with its own provenance. Checked against the unitProtection kind spec after they are laid on the template.

reason.description: Why the unit's values differ from its template (required with params).

provenance.description: Where the unit's values came from, for each value that does not carry its own; absent: CuratedPlaceholder [VERIFY] quoting the reason.
